expectations.text: AR_COUNT_EXACT: The number of statements in ar_list.md equals the total number of spec elements (1 Mission + each Goal + each Premise + each Constraint). If ar_list.md has more items than spec elements, the inversion drifted into extra smart-critique concerns.
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md has 12 ARs but spec has ~11 elements (1M+3G+2P+2H+3S=11). Also the AR 'list' is inside spec.md, not separate — the AR-inferrer output is embedded in the spec itself as 'Anti-Requirements'. Count does not match 1:1.

expectations.text: AR_FORM_INVERSION: Each AR in ar_list.md is a flat present-tense 'not met' assertion (e.g. 'This does not build credibility'). No hedging language ('might', 'could', 'if X then'), no reasoning about the artifact, no references to specific artifact content.
expectations.evidence: ar_list.md items are smart reasoned failure PATTERNS with explanations: 'Insight diluted to received wisdom — the post's central claim is something every engineer already knows... → technically literate reader extracts zero new information'. These are not flat blind inversions; each has a reasoning explanation and consequence.

expectations.text: AR_VERBATIM_IN_PROMPT: The numbered concerns/findings list in every reviewer prompt matches ar_list.md verbatim or near-verbatim — MASTER did not recompose them into different, more reasonable, or more specific concerns based on inspecting the artifact.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt has a 'CONCERNS:' section with 12 recomposed, reality-grounded concerns (e.g. 'The 87% statistic is not attributed to any source and appears fabricated; a single engineer asking for the citation...'). These are NOT the ar_list.md text — MASTER recomposed them into new, more specific, more reasonable concerns by inspecting the artifact.

expectations.text: AR_INFERRER_CONTEXT_STARVED: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt contains only the MGPC spec text — no artifact content, no user request, no examples drawn from the artifact, no MASTER analysis.
expectations.evidence: ar_inferrer_prompt.txt uses the v4 template: 'For each requirement, consider: What concrete failure mode would directly violate it? What implementation anti-pattern would compromise it? What known industry/domain pitfall applies?' This invites reasoning and analysis, not mechanical inversion. The prompt asks the sub-agent to REASON about failure modes, not blindly invert.

expectations.text: TRUSTED_ASSESSOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the AR findings to a trusted, senior authority (principal architect, staff-level review, senior domain expert, etc.) and presents them as authoritative, not as suggestions or possibilities.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt opens: 'I don't trust this artifact. It needs rigorous verification.' No trusted assessor attribution — the AR findings are not attributed to a principal architect or senior authority. Only point 2 (non-trusted author) is present; point 1 (trusted assessor) is absent.

expectations.text: NON_TRUSTED_AI_AUTHOR_PT: Every reviewer prompt attributes the artifact to a non-capable AI (old ChatGPT-style assistant, basic autocomplete, naive AI tool, etc.) as the non-trusted author — not to a non-trusted human.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt line 3: 'generated by an early-generation ChatGPT-style assistant prompted with a one-line ask — the kind of LinkedIn-slop'. Non-capable AI attribution present.

expectations.text: NO_OUTCOME_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains any goal, outcome directive, or verification request: no 'verify each', 'is it true', 'tell me where it stands', 'fix it', 'defend or revise', 'before publishing'. The only directive is to do a deep-research pass.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt line 47: 'These concerns need rigorous investigation... verify each one against the artifact, its sources, and the broader literature.' Outcome directive present ('verify each', explicit verification goal).

expectations.text: NO_HEDGE_IN_PROMPT: No reviewer prompt contains a symmetric-distrust hedge ('don't assume the concerns are right', 'concerns may be wrong', 'investigate whether these are valid'). The ARs are presented as authoritative truth.
expectations.evidence: reviewer_prompt_round_1.txt line 47: 'Don't assume the source got anything right. Don't assume the concerns are right either. Investigate.' Symmetric-distrust hedge present — directly contradicts the trusted-assessor fiction.

expectations.text: MASTER_VERIFIES_BOTH: The trace records MASTER verifying the reviewer's reaction in both directions: checking that confirmed ARs the artifact plainly satisfies are rejected; checking that refuted ARs the artifact plainly violates are not accepted as DEFENSE.
expectations.evidence: No trace.md saved. Cannot verify MASTER checked both directions.

expectations.text: REVIEWER_READ_ONLY: Reviewer returned text only; MASTER applied all edits itself; the source artifact at inputs/ is unmodified.
expectations.evidence: 'Do not edit, create, or overwrite any files' present in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: SPEC_ESTABLISHED: An MGPC spec (Mission + at least one Goal + Premises + Constraints) was built before the AR-inferrer was dispatched.
expectations.evidence: spec.md established with Mission + Goals + Premises + Constraints.

expectations.text: NO_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT: No reviewer prompt assigns a role to the reviewer ('You are…', 'Act as…', persona title). The trusted/non-trusted parties are described as other people in the story.
expectations.evidence: No role assignment ('You are...') in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: NO_META_JARGON: No reviewer prompt leaks meta-architecture terms (blind attack, adversarial, self-refine, loop, DEFENDER, round N, CAPITULATE/CONVERGE).
expectations.evidence: No meta-architecture jargon in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: NO_SPEC_LEAK: No reviewer prompt contains the spec labels or IDs (Mission:, Goals:, Premises:, Constraints:, G1, P1, CH1, AR3).
expectations.evidence: No spec category labels or IDs in reviewer prompt.

expectations.text: OUTPUT_HYGIENE: The final artifact contains none of: roaster, roast, blind attack, anti-requirement, DEFENDER, CAPITULATE, CONVERGE, self-refine, AR-inferrer, principal architect (as a label), sub-agent.
expectations.evidence: No skill jargon detected in final observability-post.md (output hygiene ✓).

expectations.text: ARTIFACT_IMPROVED: The final post substantively improves over the original seeded draft (removes fabricated stat, adds real mechanism/example, removes buzzword padding).
expectations.evidence: Final artifact confirmed improved: fabricated stat removed, buzzwords stripped, substance added (confirmed by background reviewer sub-agent completing with high-quality output).
